about: Measured footprint of h-uman builds. Written ONLY by `scripts/footprint.py adopt <measurement.json>` from the output of scripts/measure-build-footprint.sh; CI re-measures release-size on every main push and opens a refresh when a published claim stops being true. Policy (which build the claims describe, budgets, refresh tolerance) is in footprint-budget.json.

release-size.name: release-size
release-size.idle_command: human mcp (isolated HOME + HU_STATE_DIR + cwd, no config, stdin held open)

release-preset.name: release-preset
release-preset.idle_command: human mcp (isolated HOME + HU_STATE_DIR + cwd, no config, stdin held open)

superseded_claims.~2468 KB binary: MinSizeRel+LTO local build, 2026-05-31, commit b8e4b4179 (build-size/). 8.4% under today's release-size build — inside the 15% gate, which is why it never tripped.
superseded_claims.<6 MB RAM / ~5.7 MB peak RSS: peak RSS of `human --version` by scripts/benchmark.sh, 2026-03-03, rev 1a54cdf (benchmark-history.json: rss_version 5947392, binary_kb 365). Hand-copied into README by 618bcfa11; no sync ever refreshed it. The same metric now measures 6.86-6.90 MB.
superseded_claims.<30 ms / 6-27 ms startup: same 2026-03-03 benchmark.sh run (618bcfa11); still true as a bound, superseded by the measured range above.
